the seasonal variability of the Southern Ocean Polar Front (PF), which is the most important boundary between cold, high salinity Antarctic waters and warmer, low salinity subantarctic waters.

the seasonal variability of the Southern Indian Ocean circulation is much larger than what is commonly believed.
